prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly one independent 2D game Power status icon for a 256x256 consumer

Consumer contract:
The icon represents an infinitely stackable reserve called Margin: calm stored capacity that accumulates and is later spent to offset a future cost. It must remain immediately recognizable at 64x64 and 32x32.

Primary request:
Draw exactly one small, compact, perfectly centered closed concentric reserve-ring symbol. Use a substantial silver-white and ice-blue main ring, a clearly enclosed deep-indigo negative-space core that reads as unused capacity, a few restrained amethyst nodes embedded inside the ring structure, and very thin controlled gold geometric edging. Keep the topology simple, inwardly stable, and unmistakably a stored reserve rather than an active defense or attack.

Style and material:
Polished hand-painted fantasy roguelike status icon, crisp at small scale, elegant magical-mathematical geometry, cool enamel and crystal materials, strong value separation, clean readable silhouette. All magical brightness remains inside the solid object and ends at its material boundary.

Composition:
Exactly one centered symbol occupying no more than the central 46 percent of the canvas width and height. Leave an extremely wide, completely empty safety field on every side; the outer 25 percent band along every edge contains no rendered mark. Keep every ring tip, node, highlight, and ornamental edge well inside the compact central symbol.

Constraints:
No light outside the object. No outer halo, bloom, fog, haze, particles, scattered stardust, dust, sparks, shadow, projected light, detached decoration, or line extending toward any canvas edge. Do not depict a shield, flame, droplet, liquid, portal tunnel, projectile, attack ray, burst, or weapon. No character, person, face, mouth, hand, body part, creature, or scenery. No text, letters, numbers, equations, formulae, pseudo-glyphs, logo, signature, or watermark. No red or crimson color, blood, gore, mouth-adjacent strand, or mouth-emitted magic. No second icon, frame, card, panel, sprite sheet, or multiple-view layout.
